_instructions.step_1: Open Telegram, search for @BotFather and send /newbot to create your bot.
_instructions.step_2: Copy the HTTP API Token provided by BotFather (e.g. 123456789:ABCdefGhI_xyz...)
_instructions.step_3: Paste the token into the 'bot_token' field below, or enter it when prompted in console.
_instructions.step_4: Run RUN_TELEGRAM_BOT.bat to start the bot. Long polling requires NO tunnels, NO port forwarding, and NO public IPs!
